description: This file defines the 'Parser' class in the Twig templating engine, responsible for parsing tokens into an abstract syntax tree (AST) representing the template structure.

classes.name: Twig	heParser
classes.description: This class parses tokens from a Twig token stream into a structured module node representing the compiled template.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method that parses a token stream into a module node, handling node traversal and semantic validation.

methods.name: getEnvironment
methods.description: Returns the Twig environment associated with this parser.

methods.name: getVarName
methods.description: Generates a unique internal variable name for parsing.

methods.name: getBlockStack
methods.description: Returns the current block stack, deprecated.

methods.name: peekBlockStack
methods.description: Returns the top block name without removing it.

methods.name: popBlockStack
methods.description: Removes the top block name from the stack.

methods.name: pushBlockStack
methods.description: Pushes a block name onto the block stack.

methods.name: hasBlock
methods.description: Checks if a block with a given name exists.

methods.name: getBlock
methods.description: Retrieves a block node by name.

methods.name: setBlock
methods.description: Defines a block node by name.

methods.name: hasMacro
methods.description: Checks if a macro exists.

methods.name: setMacro
methods.description: Sets a macro node for a given name.

methods.name: addTrait
methods.description: Adds a trait template to the current parser context.

methods.name: hasTraits
methods.description: Checks if traits are present.

methods.name: embedTemplate
methods.description: Embeds a sub-template into the current template context.

methods.name: addImportedSymbol
methods.description: Adds an imported symbol (variable or function) to the current scope.

methods.name: getImportedSymbol
methods.description: Retrieves an imported symbol by type and alias.

methods.name: isMainScope
methods.description: Determines if the parser is in the main scope.

methods.name: pushLocalScope
methods.description: Enters a new local scope for symbol import resolution.

methods.name: popLocalScope
methods.description: Exits the current local scope.

methods.name: getExpressionParser
methods.description: Returns the expression parser instance.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent node, deprecated.

methods.name: hasInheritance
methods.description: Checks if the template extends or uses traits.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Sets the parent node (base template).

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns the token stream being parsed.

methods.name: getCurrentToken
methods.description: Returns the current token from the stream.

methods.name: filterBodyNodes
methods.description: Filters or validates nodes within the template body, ensuring compliance with Twig syntax rules.
